target.meaning: Target MAC normalized by trimming, lowercasing and converting hyphens to colons.

flags.meaning: flags.exousia.pin carries the administrative PIN, never in command-line arguments; local verifier accepts a nonempty string at most 512 bytes. On a remote target it is forwarded.

ok.meaning: The outer relay completed, even if a target entry signals failure.

answers.meaning: Entries contain mac, hostname, proven, signal and answer; signal can be null or a peer/local outcome and answer can be null.

firstMissingSignal.meaning: Fixed literal outcomes are enumerated; The enum lists fixed top-level refusals. Peer reply and nested answer signal can pass through arbitrary peer text; remote path also records a Hyalos deed.
